flags.rationale: ENABLE_SHADOW_PREVIEW is the sole live flag. Parser reads the env var and sets shadow_enabled which is consumed by preview_runtime_branch to return the shadow path. Test and docs confirm end-to-end reachability.

ENABLE_PREVIEW_V2 is parsed by the env parser as an elif branch but normalizes to the same shadow_enabled flag. There is no independent runtime branch for V2. The runbook explicitly states it is not a standalone runtime branch. Parser hit does not prove runtime reachability.

PREVIEW_FORCE_LEGACY is parsed and sets force_legacy_seen but the live service does not branch on it. The only consumer is legacy_force_label which is a reporting-only label. The test asserts the runtime branch remains legacy. The runbook confirms the live service does not branch on it anymore.

summary.note: ENABLE_SHADOW_PREVIEW is the only live flag controlling the preview router. ENABLE_PREVIEW_V2 is a dead alias and PREVIEW_FORCE_LEGACY is dead. Removing the dead/partial flags reduces config surface without runtime impact.

cleanup_plan.rationale: Sole live flag. Removing it would break the preview router. Must be kept as the canonical shadow preview toggle.
Alias with no independent runtime branch. Deprecate and redirect operators to ENABLE_SHADOW_PREVIEW.
Dead flag with no runtime effect. Can be removed after confirming no external deploy manifests still reference it.
